person_note: The controlling voice is a nonparticipating omniscient third-person narrator. Two authorized sustained excerpts show external narration of Bob, Olive, Lucy, and other characters, while whole-book structural sources independently identify third-person omniscience. The narrator’s conversational “I,” inclusive “we/us,” and universal “you” occur in commentary or aphorisms and do not make that voice a story participant. First-person material involving Lucy or Olive is dialogue or locally ambiguous character speech, not an autonomous first-person narrative section. No credible evidence of alternating base-person sections was found.
